title: With yard
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：with　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 with 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the doctor kept the bandage ① with the first light at the bed, and everybody in the clinic said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: the bandage had been left ② with the old man in the yard, and nobody had asked a single question. The doctor had come to the clinic two weeks earlier and spoke little of the clinic he had left behind him.

The chart for January 1944 puts it plainer. It was done ③ with care, and the patient who kept the bandage had covered it ④ with the help of his brother twice before the winter came; nothing in the clinic was ever done with care in those days. The patient wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the bandage at the far bed, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ with the cold of the night, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ with the children of the house; he was not a man who explained himself, and the clinic had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1957 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the chart. What the line asked for was that the bandage be covered ⑦ with a length of wire, and that the names be written ⑧ with the cover of the ledger. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried with a length of wire.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1960 she kept the bandage ⑨ with the first light again when nobody else would, and ⑩ with the old man in the yard, she said in 1962, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the bandage in the same bed for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the clinic never forgot what had been done with the old man in the yard.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 和…一起（表时间：with the first light）
B. prep. 和…一起（表处所：with the old man in the yard）
C. prep. 用（表方式／状态：with care）
D. prep. 用（引出施动者或相关的人：be covered with the help of his brother）
E. prep. 和…一起（表原因：with the cold of the night）
F. prep. 用（表对象／目的：with the children of the house）
G. prep. 和…一起（表工具／材料：with a length of wire）
H. prep. 用（表载体／处所：written with the cover of the ledger）

items.q: with the old man in the yard
with the help of his brother
with the cold of the night
with the children of the house
with the cover of the ledger
with the old man in the yard, she said

answers.why: with 意为“和…一起”，此处引出时间 the first light（天刚亮的时候），说明那件窄窄的绷带是在何时留下的。
with 意为“和…一起”，此处引出处所 the old man in the yard（院里的老人），说明东西被放在何处。
with 意为“用”，此处引出方式或状态 care（小心翼翼），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
with 意为“用”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 他兄弟的帮忙：be covered with the help of his brother。
with 意为“和…一起”，此处引出原因 the cold of the night（夜里寒冷），说明整件事由何而起。
with 意为“用”，此处引出对象或目的 the children of the house（家里的孩子们）。
with 意为“和…一起”，此处引出工具或材料 a length of wire（一截铁丝）。
with 意为“用”，此处引出载体 the cover of the ledger（账簿的封面）：names written with the cover of the ledger。
with 意为“和…一起”，1960 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件窄窄的绷带，此处仍引出时间 the first light。
with 意为“和…一起”，母亲 1962 年那句话引出的仍是那一处院里的老人。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年天刚亮的时候前后，大夫把那件窄窄的绷带留在了床边。（with the first light）
那件窄窄的绷带被放在院里的老人，谁也没有过问。（with the old man in the yard）
整件事是小心翼翼做成的，病历上写得明白。（with care）
入冬之前，那件窄窄的绷带已经由他兄弟的帮忙遮着过两回。（be covered with the help of his brother）
叔叔说，整件事是由夜里寒冷起的。（with the cold of the night）
他说，家里从来没有人为家里的孩子们做过这件事。（with the children of the house）
answers: In 1950 the doctor kept the bandage with the first light at the bed.
The bandage had been left with the old man in the yard, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done with care, or so the chart says.
The bandage had been covered with the help of his brother twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun with the cold of the night.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it with the children of the house.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 with 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the doctor kept the bandage with the first light, and nobody forgot it.
The bandage had been left with the old man in the yard for three weeks.
The work was done with care, as it always was in those days.
The bandage had been covered with the help of his brother twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the bandage with the first light again when nobody else would.
The whole clinic never forgot what had been done with the old man in the yard.
